cases.name: filter
cases.query: FOR n IN notes FILTER DOCUMENT(n.ref).v == 2 RETURN n._key

cases.name: deferred
cases.query: FOR n IN notes LET d=DOCUMENT(n.ref) LET v=d.v SORT n._key LIMIT 1 RETURN v

cases.name: dependent
cases.query: FOR n IN notes FILTER n._key == "a" LET d=DOCUMENT(n.ref) LET next=DOCUMENT(d.next) RETURN next.v

cases.name: traversal
cases.query: FOR n IN notes FILTER n._key == "a" FOR v IN 1..1 OUTBOUND n._id links RETURN v._key

cases.name: mixed
cases.query: FOR n IN notes FILTER n._key == "a" FOR v IN 1..1 OUTBOUND n._id links LET d=DOCUMENT(v._id) RETURN d.v

cases.name: array
cases.query: FOR id IN ["notes/b","notes/c"] FILTER DOCUMENT(id).v >= 2 RETURN id

cases.name: subquery
cases.query: FOR n IN notes FILTER n._key == "a" LET xs=(FOR x IN [1,2] RETURN DOCUMENT(n.ref).v) SORT n._key LIMIT 1 RETURN xs

cases.name: collect_into
cases.query: FOR n IN notes COLLECT group=1 INTO ids=DOCUMENT(n.ref)._key RETURN ids

cases.name: empty
cases.query: FOR n IN notes FILTER DOCUMENT(n.ref).v == 99 RETURN n._key

cases.name: distinct
cases.query: FOR n IN notes RETURN DISTINCT DOCUMENT(n.ref).v
